messages:
Sam Patel: ACME Health asks for an EU-only presales POC: tenant pin to eu-west-1, BYO KMS, VPC peering, and a signed sub-processor list. Can we triage owners?
Priya Nair: I'll own runbook + checklist. Need retention, audit log access, and exact subproc export.
Miguel Torres: Infra note: dedicated pool in eu-west-1 available; hosted can be locked with tenant_pin + failover disabled. We do envelope encryption (DEKs encrypted; no plaintext keys stored).
Lina Chen: Legal needs a signed PDF of subprocessors that will touch data during the POC and cert links. I'll draft a short POC addendum that forbids cross-border routing for the window.
Alex Rossi: Pricing: quick sketch - hosted hard-pin trial ~€1k/week + KMS ops; dedicated demo slab ~€5k/week. I'll post a refined number in 6h.
Priya Nair: Runbook TO-DOs: 1) CIDR/CNAME handshake & peering steps, 2) cert exchange, 3) KMS ARN verification sample, 4) smoke tests (traceroute + request-id), 5) audit log export.
Miguel Torres: Ops ticket created: RDW-1410 - "ACME EU POC: VPC peering + BYO KMS + subproc attestation" assigned to @miguel.t
ops-bot: RDW-1410 status -> "in progress"
Sam Patel: Action owners: Priya runbook; Miguel ops + subproc export; Lina addendum; Alex pricing. First draft by EOD tomorrow?
Everyone: +1
Priya Nair: One open Q - customer asked if any telemetry ever leaves EU during the POC. Can infra confirm telemetry can be scoped to eu-only for the window?
Miguel Torres: Can scope telemetry to eu-only for POC. Will include config snippet in the runbook: routing_policy: tenant_pin; allowed_regions: ["eu-west-1"]; failover: "none_unless_approved"; telemetry: "eu-only"
Lina Chen: I'll attach subproc PDF + cert links to the deal folder once Miguel exports.
Sam Patel: I'll schedule a 30-min sync with the customer after we have the runbook draft. Keeping thread for audit. :thumbsup:
